description: gryphon_playground CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that gryphon_playground is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is exactly the depends_on closure (grid_fixtures, whose grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the Gridkin corpus references by string) plus gryphon_playground itself; the consumer — the plugin-ci boot-and-test lane, or `spawn --dev-plugins gryphon_playground` locally — flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test is what runs, not the released tag. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin (the corpus asserted table sets that only existed on a stack carrying compliance_core until 2026-08-27; the oracles now derive their roster from the live registry, and this record is what keeps them honest), all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network — so a fork can run this lane and a nightly cannot flake on a third party. The Gridkin corpus builds its scenarios at query time, hence an empty population section. Reproduce CI exactly: spawn --from 'git+https://github.com/unified-systems-com/gryphon-playground-tap@<release tag>#ci' --dev-plugins gryphon_playground
